correctness.rationale: For SPD A and rank-one bb^T, nonzero active spectral components of b produce at least r distinct Lyapunov-operator eigenvalues and prevent CG breakdown in the first r steps. The exact k-th CG iterate is q_{k-1}(L_A)(bb^T), with leading coefficient (-1)^{k-1} product of positive CG step lengths. Its sum kernel q(lambda_i+lambda_j)=V C V^T has an invertible anti-triangular middle matrix C of size k; continuous removal of lower coefficients preserves its inertia, leaving alternating positive/negative pairs and, for odd k, a positive central value. The full-rank spectral-projection matrix adds n-k zeros. The exact continuous-time Gramian solution is PSD of rank r. This proves the universal first-r inertia, not later iterates or finite-precision rank. Independent Frobenius CG calculations for 15 SPD samples in dimensions 2..6 corroborated every early iterate.
residual_risks: No assertion of infinite truth rests solely on finite computation.
